/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- kernel-and-host ---' && sed -n '1,220p' materials/programming-model/kernel-and-host.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- core contract/indexing sections ---' && sed -n '250,620p' materials/dsl/core.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- core remainder ---' && sed -n '620,900p' materials/dsl/core.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- material file sizes ---' && wc -l materials/dsl/core.md materials/dsl/types-numerics-and-effects.md materials/programming-model/kernel-and-host.md"

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- working files ---' && rg --files -g '"'!materials/**'"' -g '"'!candidate.py'"' . && printf '%s\\n' '--- all material headings ---' && rg -n '"'^#{1,4} '"' materials/dsl/core.md materials/dsl/types-numerics-and-effects.md materials/programming-model/*.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- core key definitions ---' && sed -n '1,250p' materials/dsl/core.md && sed -n '430,510p' materials/dsl/core.md"
